title: LiBRA: Logit Fingerprints for Byzantine-Robust Client Selection in Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.27357v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Byzantine-robust aggregation shields federated learning from malicious updates, but the rules that filter out suspect updates do so by comparing clients' parameter vectors. That comparison requires access to every client's update, which secure aggregation exists to withhold, costs $O(n^2 d)$ in the parameter dimension $d$, and is defined only between clients that share an architecture. We propose LiBRA, which compares clients on what their models compute rather than on the parameters that compute them, using a fingerprint of $C^2$ values for $C$ classes, the class-conditional logit response of each client's model to pseudo-patterns optimised against it. We instantiate LiBRA as variants of Krum, Multi-Krum and Bulyan that change only what the dissimilarity score is computed on. On Fashion-MNIST and CIFAR-10 with three architectures and four backdoor and label-manipulation attacks under i.i.d. partitions, each variant holds every attack

translated_title: LiBRA：用于联邦学习中拜占庭鲁棒客户端选择的Logit指纹
translated_abstract: 拜占庭鲁棒聚合为联邦学习提供了抵御恶意更新的保护，但过滤可疑更新的规则是通过比较客户端的参数向量来实现的。这种比较需要访问每个客户端的更新，而安全聚合的目的恰恰是为了隐藏这些更新；这种比较在参数维度 d 上具有 O(n²d) 的计算成本；并且仅在共享相同架构的客户端之间才有定义。我们提出 LiBRA，它通过比较客户端模型计算出的结果而非计算这些结果的参数来比较客户端，使用一个包含 C² 个值的指纹（C 为类别数），即每个客户端模型对针对其优化的伪模式的类条件 logit 响应。我们将 LiBRA 实例化为 Krum、Multi-Krum 和 Bulyan 的变体，这些变体仅改变了不相似度分数的计算对象。在 i.i.d. 数据划分下，使用 Fashion-MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 数据集、三种架构以及四种后门和标签操纵攻击，每种变体都能抵御所有攻击
tldr: LiBRA通过比较客户端模型的logit指纹而非参数向量来实现联邦学习中的拜占庭鲁棒客户端选择，从而克服了传统方法需要访问原始更新、计算成本高以及仅适用于相同架构客户端的限制。
en_tdlr: LiBRA achieves Byzantine-robust client selection in federated learning by comparing clients' logit fingerprints rather than parameter vectors, overcoming the need for access to raw updates, the O(n²d) computational cost, and the requirement that clients share the same architecture.
